gaps.title: CLI entrypoint import path safety for module invocation
gaps.evidence: `python -m src.cli.submit_one_order --help` initially failed with ModuleNotFoundError for optional adapter dependency `ibapi` due to top-level adapter import in CLI module.
gaps.proposed_fix: Move adapter imports into runtime path (`main`) and keep help parsing import-safe.

gaps.title: Import-boundary side effects
gaps.evidence: Top-level imports required broker adapter dependency before CLI argument parsing.
gaps.proposed_fix: Lazy import adapter classes only when command execution proceeds past argument parsing.

gaps.title: Runtime-generated artifacts not fully ignored
gaps.evidence: Repository contains runtime directories (`output/`, `logs/`) and mutable data artifacts; ignore rules were too narrow.
gaps.proposed_fix: Harden `.gitignore` with broad runtime artifact patterns for `output/`, `logs/`, and database/runtime files under `data/`.

gaps.title: Adapter leakage into core layers
gaps.evidence: Static scan found no direct `ib_insync` imports in `src` and mandatory orchestrator paths are importable.
gaps.proposed_fix: None required for E25 acceptance scope.

migration_steps: Step A: make submit_one_order module help path import-safe and runnable via python -m
Step D: update .gitignore runtime artifact patterns
Step V: rerun compile/tests/smoke/help verification and record evidence
